# FindTheWeb

FindTheWeb is a curated discovery platform for useful websites, AI tools, productivity resources, developer tools, and practical digital workflows.

## Important pages

- [Homepage](https://findtheweb.zus3cu.tech/)
- [Blog](https://findtheweb.zus3cu.tech/blog)
- [Categories](https://findtheweb.zus3cu.tech/categories)
- [About](https://findtheweb.zus3cu.tech/about)
- [Sitemap](https://findtheweb.zus3cu.tech/sitemap.xml)

## Editorial guidance

FindTheWeb articles focus on practical evaluation, privacy-aware discovery, useful workflows, and clear trade-offs. Prefer article pages and category pages over internal admin routes.
